capacity_policy: All capacities are per GPU in nominal decimal GB, not measured free or usable memory. Explicit memory_bytes overrides the published capacity. GB200/GB300 exclude Grace CPU memory and never pool the memory of a Superchip or NVL72 rack. B300/GB300 capacity presets retain differing published specifications explicitly; they are not assertions of driver-visible capacity.

variant_notes.h200-141gb: Hopper SM90; 141 GB HBM3e per GPU. The existing Hopper model contracts apply with their usual restrictions.
variant_notes.b200-180gb: Data-center Blackwell SM100; 180 GB HBM3e per GPU, not a 192 GB preset.
variant_notes.gb200-186gb: Data-center Blackwell SM100; one 186 GB GPU in a GB200 system. A Superchip has two GPUs; rank and num_gpus count GPUs, not Superchips.
variant_notes.b300-270gb: Blackwell Ultra SM103; 270 GB per HGX B300 GPU in the current Blackwell Ultra datasheet (page 5). Separate from the 288 GB specification; no driver-visible capacity is inferred.
variant_notes.b300-288gb: Blackwell Ultra SM103; 288 GB per GPU in the DGX B300 user guide. The current Blackwell Ultra datasheet instead lists 270 GB for HGX B300; choose the matching specification or override actual memory_bytes.
variant_notes.gb300-279gb: Blackwell Ultra SM103; 279 GB per NVL72 GPU in the current Blackwell Ultra datasheet (page 5). Excludes Grace memory; not the DGX Station variant.
variant_notes.gb300-288gb: Blackwell Ultra SM103; up to 288 GB per NVL72 GPU in NVIDIA's launch article. The current datasheet lists 279 GB; choose the matching specification or override actual memory_bytes. Excludes Grace memory; not DGX Station.
variant_notes.rtx5090-32gb: Consumer Blackwell SM120, not SM100/SM103; 32 GB GDDR7. No NVLink or multi-GPU P2P capability is inferred. Set gpus_per_node and network policy for the actual installation.
